```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressMessages({ library(here); library(tidyverse); library(HGNChelper) })

out_dir <- here::here("data")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# HGNC download (once)

```{r hgnc-download}
existing_hgnc <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "^hgnc_complete_set_.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(existing_hgnc) == 0) {
  hgnc_raw_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("hgnc_complete_set_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"), ".txt"))
  hgnc <- read_tsv("https://storage.googleapis.com/public-download-files/hgnc/tsv/tsv/hgnc_complete_set.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)
  write_tsv(hgnc, hgnc_raw_path)
} else {
  hgnc_raw_path <- existing_hgnc[1]
  hgnc <- read_tsv(hgnc_raw_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

hgnc_protein_coding <- hgnc %>%
  filter(locus_group == "protein-coding gene" & !is.na(ensembl_gene_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol, locus_group, ensembl_gene_id)

t2t_gene_annot <- readRDS(here::here("data", "annotation", "T2T-CHM13v2.0_gene_annot_granges.rds"))
t2t_genes <- unique(t2t_gene_annot$gene)
```

# Restricted+control subset per library

Per-library control-term patterns, verified against each raw library file's gene column — the generic list alone misses two real control conventions: Jacquere's `NO_SITE`/`ONE_SITE_INTERGENIC` and TKOv3's `EGFP`.

```{r control-terms}
generic_control_terms <- c("CONTROL", "Control", "control", "INTRON", "Intron", "intron", "LacZ", "luciferase")
control_terms_by_library <- list(
  avana_library = generic_control_terms,
  `broadgpp-brunello-library-contents` = generic_control_terms,
  tkov3_guide_sequence = c(generic_control_terms, "EGFP"),
  yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas = generic_control_terms,
  Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4 = c(generic_control_terms, "NO_SITE", "ONE_SITE_INTERGENIC")
)
```

```{r build-subset}
base <- here::here("data", "library_data", "original_library")
restricted_dir <- here::here("data", "library_data", "restricted_library")
dir.create(restricted_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

files <- list(
  avana_library = file.path(base, "avana_library.tsv"),
  `broadgpp-brunello-library-contents` = file.path(base, "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents.tsv"),
  tkov3_guide_sequence = file.path(base, "tkov3_guide_sequence.tsv"),
  yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas = file.path(base, "yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas.tsv"),
  Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4 = file.path(base, "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4.tsv")
)

summary_rows <- list()
for (name in names(files)) {
  lib <- read_tsv(files[[name]], col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  colnames(lib) <- c("sgRNA", "spacer", "gene")

  control_pattern <- paste(control_terms_by_library[[name]], collapse = "|")
  is_control <- str_detect(lib$gene, control_pattern)
  control_rows <- lib %>% filter(is_control)

  target_rows <- lib %>% filter(!is_control)
  genes_u <- unique(target_rows$gene)
  sc <- suppressWarnings(checkGeneSymbols(genes_u)) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = x)
  lookup <- tibble(gene = sc$gene, gene_hgnc = if_else(is.na(sc$Suggested.Symbol), sc$gene, sc$Suggested.Symbol))
  target_annotated <- target_rows %>% left_join(lookup, by = "gene")
  target_restricted <- target_annotated %>% filter(gene_hgnc %in% hgnc_protein_coding$symbol, gene_hgnc %in% t2t_genes) %>%
    dplyr::select(sgRNA, spacer, gene)

  subset_lib <- bind_rows(target_restricted, control_rows) %>% arrange(sgRNA)
  write_tsv(subset_lib, file.path(restricted_dir, paste0(name, ".tsv")), col_names = FALSE)

  # Gene counts: "before" uses the raw, as-labelled gene symbol (no HGNC
  # standardization applied yet); "after" uses gene_hgnc (the standardized
  # symbol the restriction itself filters on), so two raw synonyms mapping to
  # the same approved symbol aren't double-counted post-restriction.
  n_genes_before <- length(genes_u)
  n_genes_after  <- target_annotated %>%
    filter(gene_hgnc %in% hgnc_protein_coding$symbol, gene_hgnc %in% t2t_genes) %>%
    pull(gene_hgnc) %>%
    n_distinct()

  summary_rows[[name]] <- tibble(library = name, original_rows = nrow(lib), control_rows = nrow(control_rows),
                                  total_sgrnas_before_restriction = nrow(target_rows),
                                  total_target_genes_before_restriction = n_genes_before,
                                  total_sgrnas_after_restriction = nrow(target_restricted),
                                  total_target_genes_after_restriction = n_genes_after,
                                  total_sgrnas_control_hgnc_t2t = nrow(subset_lib))
  cat(name, "-", nrow(subset_lib), "guides (", nrow(target_restricted), "targeting +", nrow(control_rows), "control )",
      "|", n_genes_before, "->", n_genes_after, "genes\n")
}

summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
supp_dir <- here::here("library_survey_supplementary_materials")
dir.create(supp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(summary_df, file.path(supp_dir, "Fig1B_working_library_composition.csv"))
```
